preflight.attribution: Coordinator pre-flight validation of the fixture, run at 21:17:43 UTC, before the native CLI session launched and therefore before any capture.
preflight.meaning: Baseline health of the knowledge layer. It says nothing about the native run.

native_capture_validation.attribution: The native execution agent's own validation of the capture it had just written, before editing reference.py.

limits: The recording truncates the controller output pane ('...+26 lines'), so the full native output is not retained anywhere.
The ok: true claim for this specific invocation rests on the agent's statement plus the visible truncated pane, not on a retained machine receipt.
This is the invocation whose timing matters; the other two records do not establish capture timing.

host_final_state.attribution: Independent coordinator host validation after the native session completed. It verifies the final captured state, not the timing or full output of the native pre-implementation command.
host_final_state.meaning: Four documents and seven local links validate cleanly, one more document than the pre-flight baseline: the captured topic is present and well-formed.
